gmailReadPermission: Read and search Gmail messages you ask Kun to use (gmail.readonly).
gmailApprovalRequired: Before sending, Kun shows the complete recipients, subject and message for your approval.
gmailLocalCredentials: OAuth credentials are encrypted locally. Google sign-in to Kun does not connect Gmail.
gmailModelRestricted: This task’s model is not available for email processing. Use Kun’s verified local Ollama model or a reviewed direct DeepSeek API account. Automatic routing, failover and user-configured localhost models cannot receive email data.
gmailLocalRecipient: Email model recipient: Kun-managed local Ollama (cloud disabled)
gmailDeepSeekRecipient: Email model recipient: DeepSeek API · api.deepseek.com
gmailDeepSeekRetention: Cloud processing and storage in China. DeepSeek enables disk context caching by default; unused caches are typically cleared after hours to days. This is not a zero-retention service.
gmailDeepSeekAccountReviewRequired: DeepSeek email processing is unavailable until this exact API account and credential have a host-recorded review of the disabled model-training setting. Connecting Gmail or checking this box cannot create that review.
gmailDeepSeekUnavailable: DeepSeek email processing is unavailable for this task’s current route or API-account review. Refresh after the host configuration is corrected. Kun will not silently switch models or accounts.
gmailLocalDownloadDetails: Downloads qwen3:4b (about 2.5 GB) if needed. It runs locally with cloud disabled; no model API key is required.
gmailLocalPreparing: Preparing the local model. You can keep Kun open while it downloads.
gmailLocalPrepareFailed: The local model is not ready. Refresh or retry preparation.
gmailLocalChooseNewTask: The local model is ready. This task retains its original model; start a new conversation using Kun Gmail Local / qwen3:4b from the normal model picker.
gmailSharingConsent: Allow Kun’s verified local model to process email data I request in this conversation.
gmailSharingDetails: Requested email headers, addresses, snippets and plain-text bodies, this conversation’s context, summaries and reply drafts are processed on this computer with model cloud features disabled.
gmailDeepSeekSharingConsent: Allow DeepSeek API (api.deepseek.com) to process email data I request in this conversation.
gmailDeepSeekSharingDetails: Kun sends requested email headers, addresses, snippets and plain-text bodies, current conversation context, summaries and reply drafts to DeepSeek’s API in China to answer my requests. DeepSeek may retain data for service and legal purposes and uses automatic context caching; Kun does not promise zero retention. The reviewed API account must keep model training disabled. Gmail OAuth credentials are not included in model requests.
gmailHistoryAndRemoteViewing: Chat and operational records may remain in protected local storage. If you enable paired-device remote access, your authenticated paired device can view this conversation through your selected connection or tunnel and its transport service. Gmail OAuth credentials are never sent to the remote device. IM bridges do not receive Gmail conversations.
gmailSharingScope: Off by default and limited to this private conversation and the recipient shown here. A local-model grant does not authorize DeepSeek. Connecting without this permission does not let the agent read email. Other conversations require their own permission.
gmailPrivacy: Gmail data use and privacy policy
gmailNotConfigured: Gmail is not configured in this app. Contact the administrator or update Kun.
gmailReconnectRequired: Your Google access has expired or was revoked. Connect Gmail again.
gmailWaiting: Complete Google authorization in your system browser, then return to Kun.
gmailStatusFailed: Could not check Gmail access. Refresh and try again.
gmailCancelled: Authorization cancelled. You can reconnect when ready.
gmailExpired: This authorization attempt expired. Start a new one.
gmailAuthorizationFailed: Google authorization was not completed. Check the permissions and try again.
gmailPollFailed: Could not check authorization. Use Refresh or cancel and retry.
gmailActionFailed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
gmailGrantRequired: Connect Gmail and allow model sharing for this conversation before continuing.
gmailDisconnectDetails: Disconnecting deletes local Gmail credentials and all conversation grants. Existing chat history remains until you delete it.
gmailRevokeWarning: Google revocation can remove grants for other Kun OAuth clients in this Google project, including Google sign-in. You may need to authorize those clients again. Existing local chat history will remain.
gmailReady: Gmail is available to this conversation
